The '''Treasure Hunter''' is a [[tackle]] that helps [[fishing]] by preventing [[fish]] from escaping while collecting [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|treasure chests]] and by increasing the chance to find treasure chests by 5% (10% if the player is using an [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] with 2 Treasure Hunters). It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] or purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|750}} after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 7]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{tprice|250}}.

==Notes==
It is cheaper to purchase a Treasure Hunter at the [[Fish Shop]] than to purchase the [[Gold Ore]] and [[Coal]] required to make 2 [[Gold Bar]]s.
